title: Little Gymnasts
description: Preschool and Prep gymnastics classes at Trident Gymnastics Ringwood. EduGym Adventurers and Foundation from 3 years 6 months, plus casual PlayGym.
blurb: Where our youngest athletes take their first steps: coached classes for kinder and Prep, from 3 years 6 months.
heroNote: Already enrolled in EduGym Adventurers? PlayGym sessions are free. Just let our staff know when you arrive.

levels.name: Adventurers
levels.description: An independent class easing children into the gymnastics structure, building confidence, listening skills and movement foundations on their own. Suits kinder and early Prep.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: The step up from Adventurers, and where Prep children start the EduGym pathway: core shapes, rolls and safe landings, leading into Level 1 in Grade 1.

media.subtitle: A look at what a session with our youngest gymnasts is really like
